name: Document Extraction Skill
description: Pulls structured fields (dates, parties, amounts, clauses) out of unstructured documents such as contracts, invoices, and forms.

name: SQL Generation Skill
description: Translates a natural-language question into a parameterized SQL query against a registered enterprise schema.

name: Policy Compliance Checker Skill
description: Checks generated or retrieved content against a configurable rulebook (e.g. internal policy, regulatory clause) before it reaches a user.
